exposure: grand multiparous parturients (current delivery ≥6) who underwent labor induction or augmentation
multiparous parturients (delivery 2-5) who underwent induction or augmentation
grand multiparous parturients with no induction or augmentation of labor
cohort: Parturients with a prior cesarean delivery undergoing trial of labor after cesarean delivery at 24-42 gestational weeks with vertex presentation between the years 2003-2015.
finding: The study found no association between grand multiparity and uterine rupture in women with a scarred uterus who underwent labor induction or augmentation.
mod_finding: Labor induction/augmentation during trial of labor after cesarean delivery in grand multiparous parturients appears to be a reasonable option with a similar uterine rupture risk as in multiparous parturients.
